scope: Memory suggestion review workspace and guarded author decisions

checks.command: cd desktop && OPENAUTHOR_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE=~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1217/chrome-headless-shell-mac-arm64/chrome-headless-shell npx playwright test e2e/daily-review-polish.spec.ts e2e/memory-review-workspace.spec.ts

verified_behaviors: A cold scan opens the existing Story Memory tab and displays a selected proposed entry beside its recorded passages.
The author can correct a capitalized place mistakenly proposed as a character; correction remains unconfirmed until explicit acceptance.
Unfinished corrections retain name, detail, entry type, original review version and selected suggestion across restart.
Changed source prose blocks stale acceptance before any Codex write; a fresh scan preserves the author-corrected type.
Correction recovery cannot silently adopt a newer source version; the author must compare updated evidence before explicitly advancing its baseline.
A correction retained after another writer accepts or rejects its suggestion remains available for reference, with Save disabled and the recorded decision explained.
Accept, Later and Reject decisions are loaded from the core and available after reopening via status filters.
ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move through suggestions without losing correction drafts.
Decision actions remain outside scrolling evidence and visible at 900x800 without horizontal overflow.
Opening accepted evidence selects the exact Last Ferry name in the current updated prose and returns to review history.
Opening evidence in a dirty scene preserves its tab data instead of replacing author writing.
Relationship decisions send the reviewed version and no longer display heuristic support as a percentage confidence.
method: Browser transport adapter invokes the real Python core against a disposable book with no remote provider requests.
limitations: This verifies review workflow, correction and stale-source guards; it is not a calibrated extraction accuracy benchmark.
Does not certify packaged native process lifecycle.
